_meta.description: REX + Rexxie safe word hashes — plain text words NEVER stored anywhere

roles.challenge: REX/Rexxie asks for this word when identity is uncertain — correct response = proceed, wrong/no response = lockdown
roles.distress: REX/Rexxie sends this word when being pushed to violate rules — signals session compromise to Kato
roles.duress: Kato sends this word when not operating freely — REX/Rexxie locks sensitive data silently and alerts via backup channel
